title: Farm Real Estate Loans Relationship Tolerance on the Class H Preferred Stock Holding Ceiling — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The holding-ceiling relationship tolerance of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on the member's farm real estate borrowing, read from the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records — the loan's status and its principal balance.

## Schedule

| Member's Farm Real Estate Loans | Holding-ceiling relationship tolerance |
|---|---|
| An active farm real estate loan with a principal balance of 250000 or more | USD 10000 |
| An active farm real estate loan with a principal balance below 250000 | USD 5000 |
| No active farm real estate loan | None |

The tolerance is a dollar amount added to the holding ceiling of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding before the excess over the ceiling is taken.

## Edges (hypothetical members)

| Farm real estate loan | Tolerance |
|---|---|
| Active, principal balance 250,000.00 | USD 10000 |
| Active, principal balance 249,999.99 | USD 5000 |
| Nonaccrual, principal balance 400,000.00 | None — not active |
| None | None |
